tasks.title: ConversationExport scope and collision-free logical identity
tasks.gate: §13.5 / §14.3 / §15.1 / §18 Phase 7: ConversationExport binds app_id and listed_tool_surface_sha256 to the connection, tool input never accepts app_id, and raw hyphenated App IDs remain unchanged in local_app_<id> and mcp__local_app_<id>__<tool>

plantedFailure.edit: accept app_id in a per-App tool input or normalize abc--1 into an ambiguous underscore server

tasks.notes: The existing global local_apps management MCP remains available; this task adds the managed per-App view.

tasks.title: One physical Local App hub with managed logical server lifecycle
tasks.gate: §15.2 / §15.4 / §18 Phase 7: 100 logical Local App servers share one in-process physical LocalAppsMcpTransport, each published active catalog is registered/unregistered at commit, and a single broadcast bus carries filtered listChanged events

plantedFailure.edit: allocate one physical transport or socket for each of 100 logical apps, or emit listChanged for unchanged/staging catalogs

tasks.notes: Logical records remain lightweight; exposed tool DTO snapshots are bounded by the conversation exposure budget.

tasks.title: Active catalog routing, surface freshness and MCP result/error mapping
tasks.gate: §13.5 / §15.4 / §18 Phase 7: list uses the connection app scope and active immutable catalog, build-only updates retain calls through the old surface digest, surface changes return tool_surface_stale before refresh, and protocol/tool/business/schema failures stay in their required layers

plantedFailure.edit: treat catalog_sha256 changes as surface staleness, expose App B through App A, or return schema/business failures as JSON-RPC protocol errors

tasks.notes: Execution remains Host Flow-only and uses Phase 5 schema/ceiling/output helpers.

tasks.title: Lazy per-conversation exposure, LRU pinning and bounded concurrency
tasks.gate: §14.4 / §15.3 / §18 Phase 7: exposure is capped at 8 logical servers, eviction spares pinned/in-flight servers, the ninth all-pinned request fails with exposure_capacity_reached, calls are bounded/rate-limited/cancellable, and audit records contain only redacted digests and timing

plantedFailure.edit: expose a ninth pinned app, queue unlimited calls, or write full tool payloads/secrets into Local App audit records

tasks.notes: Phase 8 UI only consumes the exposure/pin seams; no native UI or protocol major bump is included.
